item.text: {"question_id":"3B.7","answer":"Protection was enacted and partly organized, but effective, equitable protection was not established. During or immediately before 2023, the government promulgated a conflict-related sexual-violence protection and reparations framework, including access to justice, victim and witness protection, health care, rehabilitation, compensation, restitution, and guarantees of non-repetition; it also reported gender-based-violence services, mobile clinics, safe spaces, police stations, community policing near displacement camps, and an inquiry into alleged FARDC violence (BATCH-0029-E002; BATCH-0011-E003; BATCH-0011-E006). Tshisekedi is directly credited with promulgating the December 2022 framework and signing the Indigenous-peoples protection law, but the supplied evidence does not show 2023 enforcement, funding sufficiency, or outcomes for the latter (BATCH-0029-E002; BATCH-0001-E010). Government-reported measures included free maternity and newborn care, schooling continuity for displaced children, and 9,500 women receiving socioeconomic-integration assistance, but these reports lack independent verification and do not establish equitable national coverage (BATCH-0010-E006; BATCH-0011-E006). Much of the documented service delivery was instead implemented by UNFPA, NGOs, ICRC, or partners: UNFPA data show only 4% government implementation of its gender-based-violence programme, 3% for gender and social norms, 3% for quality of care, and 14% for maternal-death reduction (BATCH-0029-E006); ICRC assistance to 3,233 survivors likewise does not demonstrate presidential funding or direction (BATCH-0002-E010). Conditions remained severely unsafe and unequal: sexual violence increased in eastern DRC, displaced women and girls faced heightened rape and assault risks and limited access to medical, psychosocial, legal, and socioeconomic support, and displacement reached a record 6.9 million, with remote areas receiving little or no assistance and child recruitment increasing (BATCH-0008-E003; BATCH-0013-E014). Nationally, discrimination, widespread gender-based violence, rare convictions, child recruitment, and limited Indigenous access to public services persisted (BATCH-0002-E022). Forced evictions and abuses involving companies, government authorities, police, and military personnel, together with ineffective grievance and remedy mechanisms, further show protection failures, although the evidence does not prove Tshisekedi personally directed those abuses (BATCH-0010-E018).","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0029-E002","BATCH-0011-E003","BATCH-0011-E006","BATCH-0010-E006","BATCH-0001-E010"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0029-E006","BATCH-0002-E010","BATCH-0008-E003","BATCH-0013-E014","BATCH-0002-E022","BATCH-0010-E018"],"limitations_and_gaps":["Government funding, implementation, enforcement, and outcomes are not consistently separable from UN, NGO, ICRC, or other humanitarian contributions.","Several favorable measures are self-reported or formal and lack independent evidence of enforcement, coverage, remedy, or equitable regional access.","Most adverse conflict and humanitarian evidence is regional, involves state and non-state actors, or documents conditions without assigning personal responsibility to Tshisekedi.","The supplied evidence does not establish a complete national measure of protection for all vulnerable groups or prove that the Indigenous-peoples law was implemented during 2023."],"corrections_made":["Removed the implication that UNFPA, ICRC, and partner service outputs were presidentially funded, directed, or implemented.","Separated formal enactment and government-reported measures from independently attributed service delivery and demonstrated outcomes.","Preserved the distinction between severe adverse conditions and evidence that does not establish Tshisekedi’s personal direction or causation.","Added the supplied funding-share evidence showing limited government implementation in relevant UNFPA programmes.","Retained contrary evidence while qualifying its evidentiary status, temporal fit, geographic scope, and attribution."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":[]}
